_note: Base 3D geometry types for grocery products. Each product gets one type from the OpenAI Decisions API; the 3D model is the base mesh scaled to the product's pack size, with the product image as texture. aspect = typical w:h:d (width, height, depth as it stands on a shelf).

can.desc: Metal cylinder can: canned food (hermetikk), soda/beer can, tinned fish

pet_bottle.desc: Plastic drink bottle with narrow neck: soda, water, juice, iced tea, smoothie

glass_bottle.desc: Glass bottle: wine, cider, saft, oil, vinegar, sauces like soy or tabasco

jug.desc: Large plastic jug or canister with handle: 5 l water, liquid detergent, big saft

squeeze_bottle.desc: Flat-oval plastic bottle with flip cap: shampoo, shower gel, dish soap, ketchup, dressing, lotion

pump_bottle.desc: Bottle with pump or trigger spray: hand soap, cleaning spray

aerosol.desc: Pressurised spray can or roll-on: hairspray, deodorant, whipped cream spray

gable_carton.desc: Gable-top carton: milk, juice, cream, oat drink 1-2 l

brick_carton.desc: Flat-top tetra brick: small juice, cooking cream, sauce, plant milk brick

box.desc: Rigid cardboard box: cereal, pasta, tea, crispbread, frozen pizza, detergent tabs, capsules, toys

jar.desc: Glass or plastic jar with screw lid: jam, pesto, pickles, baby food, honey, spice jar, vitamins

tub.desc: Round or square tub/cup with lid: yoghurt, ice cream, butter, cottage cheese, spread, salads, dessert

tray.desc: Plastic tray sealed with film: fresh meat, fish, chicken, minced meat, ready meals

vacuum_pack.desc: Thin flat vacuum or flow-wrap pack: sliced cheese, cold cuts, salami, sausages, smoked salmon, bacon

block.desc: Wrapped solid block: cheese block, brunost, butter block, marzipan, yeast, block of chocolate for cooking

bar.desc: Flat wrapped bar or slab: chocolate bar, protein bar, candy bar, chewing gum pack

pillow_bag.desc: Puffy sealed bag: chips, candy, frozen vegetables, fries, frozen berries, nuts, snacks

standup_pouch.desc: Stand-up pouch with flat bottom: coffee, granola, rice, baby food pouch, pet food, refill packs

paper_sack.desc: Block-bottom paper bag: flour, sugar, oats, potato flour

sachet.desc: Small flat paper or foil packet: spice mix, sauce mix, soup powder, yeast sachet, sweeteners

tube.desc: Squeeze tube: toothpaste, tomato paste, caviar, mayonnaise tube, cream

loaf.desc: Bread or baked goods in a bag: loaf, baguette, rolls, buns, cake, lefse

produce_round.desc: Loose roundish fruit or vegetable: apple, orange, melon, tomato, avocado, onion, lettuce head, cabbage, broccoli

produce_long.desc: Loose elongated produce: cucumber, banana, leek, carrot, zucchini, corn

net_bag.desc: Produce in a net or loose plastic bag: potatoes, onions, clementines, carrots, apples in bag

clamshell.desc: Clear plastic punnet or clamshell: berries, cherry tomatoes, grapes, cut fruit, salad mix, herbs, sprouts

multipack.desc: Shrink-wrapped or cardboard multipack of bottles, cans or cups: 6x0.33 l, 4x150 g yoghurt

roll_pack.desc: Pack of paper rolls: toilet paper, kitchen roll

soft_pack.desc: Soft plastic-wrapped brick: diapers, sanitary pads, wet wipes, napkins, cotton pads

flat_pack.desc: Thin flat item or pack: tortillas, pizza base, paper plates, A4 paper, magazine, book, baking paper

blister_card.desc: Hanging card with blister or hang tab: batteries, light bulbs, pens, plasters, pacifiers, small hardware

irregular.desc: Anything else with no packaging shape: kitchen utensils, clothing, toys without box, whole chicken, vase
